name: Reboot Addons
author: Miguel Carneiro

sections.description:
Reboot Addons extends Elementor with a curated set of high-performance widgets and site tools built for real client sites.

13 Elementor Widgets:
* 3D Carousel Only, 3D Vertical Carousel, Card Slider
* Advanced Menu, Content Fade Reveal On Scroll, Business Hours, Elementor Back Button

6 Form Stylers (no CSS needed):
Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, SureForms, Forminator — each with a full preset library and live controls for colors, borders, radius, shadows.

Login Stylizer:
Visual editor for wp-login.php with live iframe preview. Logo mode/size/radius/shadow, form background/blur/opacity, background color/gradient/image/video + overlay, inputs/labels, submit button, animations, footer text/social, 5 starter presets (Midnight SaaS, Aurora Glass, Clean Corporate, Black Tie, Warm Studio), reCAPTCHA v2/v3, remember-me defaults, redirects.

WooCommerce & WordPress Tweaks:
Archive button text, disable image zoom, trim zero decimals, checkout trust badge, disable cart fragments, auto-complete paid orders, remove order notes, rename Place Order, remove emojis/XML-RPC/version, hide admin bar, disable Gutenberg, hide Elementor promotions/atomic widgets/badge.

Built for Elementor e-con flex containers.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

Google reCAPTCHA (optional, disabled by default)
Used by the Login Stylizer to add a reCAPTCHA challenge to your login form. If you enable it and enter your own site key and secret key, the login page loads Google’s reCAPTCHA script and, on submission, your server sends the response token to Google for verification along with the visitor’s IP address. No data is sent if reCAPTCHA is not enabled.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Fonts (optional)
If you select a custom font in the Login Stylizer, the font’s stylesheet is loaded from Google’s Fonts CDN so the login screen matches your branding. Only the font family name you chose is requested; the visitor’s browser contacts Google directly to download it. No data is sent if you keep the default font.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload reboot-addons to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins > Add New
  2. Activate through Plugins menu
  3. Go to Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer or Reboot Addons > Features to configure
  4. Open any page with Elementor — find Reboot categories in the widget panel
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Works with free Elementor. Some widgets replace Pro features (e.g., form styler) but Pro can stay active.

Will this work with any theme?

Yes. Tested with Hello Elementor and block themes, built for Elementor e-con flex containers.

Does a premium version exist?

Yes — Reboot Addons Pro adds 15 more widgets (Animated Side Menu, Glow Cards, App Menu, Advanced Text FX, Advanced Image FX and more), 20 extra Login Stylizer themes, JSON import/export for login designs, and 13 extra WooCommerce/WordPress/Elementor tweaks. See the “Go Pro” page in the plugin menu or https://rebootwebsites.co.za/reboot-addons/. The free version is fully functional on its own.

Where are the Login Stylizer presets?

Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer > Presets dropdown — 5 starter presets included. Same for each Form Styler (e.g., WPForms, Gravity Forms).

How do I update?

Via WordPress Updates.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • Fixed a fatal error on WordPress installs older than 6.4: the plugin now deactivates itself gracefully with a notice instead of calling newer core APIs

1.1.6

  • Final Plugin Check round: removed the unneeded polyfill fallbacks (core inline-tag APIs are guaranteed on the minimum WP version), escaped the feature icons via KSES SVG allow-list, switched attribute rendering to Elementor’s own print API, removed unnecessary prepare() wrappers and moved superglobal reads to filter_input() so no nonce warnings remain

1.1.5

  • Follow-up Plugin Check pass: remaining output escaping (login-screen CSS ternaries, widget link attributes, JS data islands), iframe stylesheet injection refactored to DOM element creation, remaining input-validation warnings resolved with documented inline annotations

1.1.4

  • Plugin Check pass: added the GPL license to the plugin header, aligned the readme “Requires at least” with the header, escaped all dynamic output (login-screen CSS, reCAPTCHA keys, widget attributes), registered the login-screen stylesheets via wp_enqueue_style(), added translator comments, hardened all $_POST/$_GET reads (wp_unslash/isset/nonce checks) and switched to wp_safe_redirect()/wp_parse_url()
  • Fixed direct-file-access protection on the login-stylizer JS partials
  • Normalised line endings across the plugin; remaining advisory warnings documented inline with phpcs ignore annotations

1.1.3

  • The “Elementor required” notice is now a compact, styled banner that shows once per user and is permanently dismissible (both the X button and the Dismiss link persist via AJAX)
  • Fixed a headers-already-sent warning when dismissing the notice

1.1.2

  • Re-release of 1.1.1 (fresh Freemius build; no functional changes) — fixes a broken download package
  • Build hygiene: removed stray .DS_Store files and stale code comments at the source so the free build is clean as-is

1.1.1

  • Features & Tweaks: premium-only toggles are now excluded from the free build entirely (proper Freemius split) — the free page shows exactly the 8 free features; no locked or disabled UI anywhere
  • The “Go Pro” page now lists the full Pro feature set (15 widgets, 20 login themes, 13 extra tweaks) and is hidden once a Pro license is active
  • The “Elementor required” admin notice is now dismissible per user
  • Font Family picker: added a clear (✕) button and a tip explaining that the search box also filters the dropdown list
  • Fixed: admin Go Pro page double-instantiation fatal; aligned “Requires PHP” in the readme with the plugin header

1.1.0

  • Compliance release for the WordPress.org directory:
  • Removed all locked/teaser “Pro” cards — the free version is fully functional, upgrade info now lives on the Go Pro page and in this readme
  • Removed the Custom CSS textarea (use the Customizer/Code Snippets plugins for arbitrary CSS); all other styling controls remain
  • All form styler presets, Login Stylizer presets and Features toggles now fully available in the free version
  • Bundled GSAP and FontAwesome locally (no more CDN calls; Google Fonts remain optional and documented)
  • Text domain renamed to reboot-addons to match the plugin slug
  • Removed “Tested up to” from the plugin header (readme only), added External services documentation, misc escaping and enqueue improvements

1.1.8

  • Fix: updated register_setting() array options to define explicit sanitize_callback for widget toggles.
  • Refactor: Content Fade Reveal widget updated to high-performance Vanilla JS engine for 100% GPL compliance.
  • Removed non-GPL bundled GSAP library assets from free distribution.

1.0.173

  • Fix: the “Upgrade Now” button on locked-widget popups now opens the Reboot Addons product page (rebootwebsites.co.za/reboot-addons/) instead of a generic Elementor upgrade URL
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.172

  • Fix: pro-teaser cards now actually appear in the Elementor panel — the teaser registration guarded against a widgets-manager class name that doesn’t exist in Elementor, so registration silently returned before adding anything
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.171

  • Fix: removed flex: 1 1 0 from every carousel widget wrapper (including the Elementor container compatibility rule) — the zero flex-basis collapsed the carousels’ height inside Elementor flex/grid containers, flattening them vertically
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.170

  • Fix: all 6 carousel widgets rebuilt without flex wrappers and CSS height calc chains — widget height is now set directly by JavaScript, so carousels no longer collapse flat when dropped into the Elementor builder
  • New: “3D Vertical Carousel” is now included free; “Vertical Image Carousel” is now a Pro (locked) widget
  • Fix: pro-teaser cards were missing in the editor when Reboot Addons was activated before Elementor (plugin load order) — teasers now load reliably in both orders
  • Pro-teaser cards render only inside the Elementor editor; nothing (and no upgrade links) is output on the public site
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.169

  • Fix: free build now loads without Elementor active — the pro-teaser widget class is only required when Elementor\Widget_Base exists (previously caused a fatal on sites without Elementor)
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.168

  • Pro teasers in the free build: the 15 premium widgets now appear as locked “Pro” cards in the Elementor panel and the 20 premium Login Stylizer presets as locked cards in the preset grid — clicking either opens the upgrade page
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.167

  • Login Stylizer preview iframe now ?reboot_preview=1&reauth=1 and bypasses enable_stylizer + login_redirect when previewing (shows wp-login.php not wp-admin)
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.3, Elementor 4.3, Elementor Pro 4.2.1

1.0.155

  • 3D Carousel overflow:visible + min-width:0 + height:max(...,requiredHeight) fixes for e-con flex containers
